description.en-US: Official Android apps from CYBER FRACTURE. Independent software, directly from the developer.

Pixel Gallery Redirect receives Pixel Camera's photo-preview request and opens the installed media viewer you choose. Select a gallery once, or choose Ask every time from the app icon.
The app forwards only the camera's content URI and temporary read access. It has no network permission, photo-library permission, background service, or third-party runtime dependencies.
It uses the Google Photos package ID required by Pixel Camera. It cannot be installed beside Google Photos or another app using that package ID.
